english.toefl: 79 with each component 16 (before January 21, 2026); 4.5 with each 4.0 (after January 21, 2026)
english.note: Duolingo each component 110. Official scores sent directly are required before review. Prior US degree may qualify for exemption; other exemptions are case-by-case based on government language and medium of instruction after official transcript submission. Department specifies TOEFL/IELTS within two years of planned entry and also describes possible US degree or two full-time US semester exemptions; confirm central approval.

applicationFee.note: International fee; domestic fee $60. Waivers limited to current Auburn graduate students enrolled in graduate courses, full-time Auburn employees, active-duty military with confirmation, and second application to approved dual program. Select eligible category and supply documentation. International eligibility for a particular route must be confirmed; no general hardship waiver established.

documents: GRE General scores directly from testing agency
Letter of intent with research interests, experience, goals and any prospective-supervisor contact
Three recommendations sent directly by referees
requirements.note: Bachelor or equivalent with strong biology-related preparation; GPA3.0 preferred. GRE scores within five years of planned entry. Program describes PhD building on MS or similar experience, rather than an explicit universal MS prerequisite.

funding.note: TA/RA availability depends on faculty grants. Department PhD assistantships normally three years, possible one-year extension subject to funds/progress; awards temporary and performance-dependent. Stipend negotiated with advisor. Most full-time assistantship students may receive course tuition waivers; online courses excluded. Student fees/tuition can remain applicant responsibility; no full-funding guarantee.
